item.title: Toyota Veloz Cross
item.description:
Toyota Veloz Cross — The Ideal Family MPV

The Toyota Veloz Cross is our most popular 7-seat vehicle, combining generous interior space with modern comfort features. Whether you need it for a family weekend getaway, a group tour around Ho Chi Minh City, or a long-distance road trip to Đà Lạt or Mũi Né, the Veloz Cross handles it all with ease.

Why Rent the Veloz Cross?

  • Spacious cabin: Three rows of seating comfortably fit 7 adults with luggage
  • Smooth automatic transmission: Easy to drive even in HCMC traffic
  • Modern safety features: ABS, dual airbags, reverse camera
  • Fuel efficient: Petrol engine with excellent city and highway economy
  • Reliable: Toyota’s legendary build quality and reliability

Ideal Use Cases

Use Case Why Veloz Cross?
Family road trip 7 seats + large trunk = perfect packing space
Airport transfer Comfortable for 5–6 people with luggage
Group city tour Easy to park, easy to drive
Inter-city travel HCMC → Đà Lạt, Vũng Tàu, Mũi Né

Booking Notes

  • Fuel is not included in the rental price — you receive and return the car with the same fuel level
  • A refundable security deposit is required at time of pickup
  • The rental clock starts from the time you receive the car
  • Overtime fee applies for late returns: 50,000 VND/hour

item.title: VinFast Fadil
item.description:
VinFast Fadil — Vietnam’s City Champion

The VinFast Fadil is Vietnam’s most popular compact hatchback, and for good reason. Its small footprint makes it ideal for navigating HCMC’s busy streets and tight parking spots, while its modern interior keeps you comfortable all day long.

Why Rent the Fadil?

  • Best value: Our most affordable rental option
  • Easy to drive: Compact dimensions and automatic transmission make it stress-free
  • Great fuel economy: Go further for less
  • Made in Vietnam: Supporting domestic automotive industry

Ideal Use Cases

Use Case Why Fadil?
Solo city explorer Easy parking, small turning radius
Couple on a trip Cozy and efficient
Business errands Professional look, great economy
Short day trips HCMC → Vũng Tàu day trip

Booking Notes

  • Fuel is not included in the rental price
  • Refundable security deposit required
  • Overtime fee: 50,000 VND/hour for late returns
  • Maximum recommended occupancy: 4 adults + 1 child (or 5 slim adults)

item.title: Mitsubishi Attrage
item.description:
Mitsubishi Attrage — Comfort Meets Efficiency

The Mitsubishi Attrage is a refined 5-seat sedan that strikes the perfect balance between comfort, practicality, and running costs. With its spacious boot and smooth ride quality, it’s a favourite for business travellers and those embarking on longer journeys across Vietnam.

Why Rent the Attrage?

  • Large boot: 430-litre trunk fits multiple large suitcases
  • Smooth ride: Comfortable on both city roads and highways
  • Excellent fuel economy: One of the most efficient cars in its class
  • Professional appearance: Great for business meetings
  • Reliable brand: Mitsubishi’s trusted engineering

Ideal Use Cases

Use Case Why Attrage?
Business travel Professional look, comfortable ride
Airport transfer 2–4 passengers with full luggage
Long-distance trip HCMC → Đà Lạt or Nha Trang
Family weekend Economical 5-seat option

Booking Notes

  • Fuel is not included in the rental price
  • Refundable security deposit required
  • Overtime fee: 50,000 VND/hour for late returns
  • Valid Vietnamese or international driver’s license required
